text:
Item 14. Principal Accountant Fees and Services.
HTL was appointed by the Company to serve as its independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal years ended December 31, 2023. During
the period from January 11, 2022 to October 9, 2023, Ernst & LLP (“Ernst”) served as the independent registered public accounting firm of the
Company. This section is a summary of the fees paid or to be paid to Ernst and WWC for services rendered.
